name: 34614 · Weeki Wachee, FL
findings: ZIP 34614 (Weeki Wachee) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34614 (Weeki Wachee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34614 (Weeki Wachee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
